title: v0.1.0 — Repository foundation
description: Monorepo skeleton, shared tooling, CI that can fail. Nothing is published yet.

title: v0.2.0 — Plugin core
description: CSS compiles to a working Tailwind plugin with prefix, include/exclude and the differential test harness proving the two paths agree.

title: v0.3.0 — First component set
description: Button, badge, input, checkbox, select, tooltip. Enough surface to prove the authoring conventions hold.

title: v0.4.0 — Svelte bindings
description: First framework package, published alongside the plugin. Establishes the binding contract the other two follow.

title: v0.5.0 — React bindings
description: React package with ESM and CJS output, matching Svelte's component inventory exactly.

title: v0.6.0 — Vue bindings
description: Vue package completing the three-framework set, with an export-parity test across all three.

title: v0.7.0 — Documentation site
description: Public site with per-component pages, live previews for all three frameworks, and install instructions.

title: v0.8.0 — Theming
description: Custom themes from a seed colour, per-role seeds, shape tokens, and a theme generator in the docs.

title: v0.9.0 — Accessibility and hardening
description: Keyboard and screen-reader audit, contrast enforcement, visual regression coverage, migration guides.

title: v1.0.0 — Stable API
description: Plugin option surface and class names frozen. Semantic versioning applies in earnest from here.

title: Backlog
description: Accepted but unscheduled. Pull into a version milestone when it becomes next.
